checkpoints.title: Owned task state before persistence
checkpoints.contract: Keep at most 32 tasks with private fields, nonempty titles of at most 200 UTF-8 bytes and no control characters. Add validates before mutation; complete is idempotent and reports missing IDs. This stage has no file format or I/O.

checkpoints.title: Complete current reference
checkpoints.contract: The complete documented reference contract, including later project features. This is explicitly the final checkpoint, not an earlier milestone.
